title: Google’s satellite AI server transmits its first response to Earth

claims.claim: Google's AI chip-equipped satellite generated its first response from space.

evidence.quote: Google’s AI chip-equipped satellite has generated its first response from space.

claims.claim: Google announced this in a blog post on Friday.

evidence.quote: In a blog post on Friday, Google says it successfully booted up the satellite’s Tensor Processing Units (TPUs)

claims.claim: The satellite successfully booted up its Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) and ran the Gemma 4 model.

evidence.quote: Google says it successfully booted up the satellite’s Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), allowing the on-board Gemma 4 model to follow through on a prompt to create a haiku about being in space

claims.claim: The Project Suncatcher satellite generated a haiku about being in space.

evidence.quote: The Project Suncatcher satellite generated a haiku about being in space.

claims.claim: Google launched the satellite into orbit earlier this month.

evidence.quote: Google launched the satellite into orbit earlier this month.

claims.claim: Google plans to evaluate how TPUs perform under thermal stress and radiation exposure in orbit.

evidence.quote: Next, we will continue with a series of tests to evaluate how TPUs perform under thermal stress and radiation exposure in orbit

claims.claim: Google's next milestone involves twin interconnected satellites in 2027.

evidence.quote: Verifying our TPUs can reliably execute workloads in space paves the way for our next milestone of twin interconnected satellites in 2027.
